args.question: How do I beat Zed as Ahri mid?
claims: Ahri can punish Zed's missed Razor Shuriken while contesting his last hits.
Zed's Living Shadow has a 20-second base cooldown at rank one.
When Zed casts Death Mark on Ahri, he reappears behind her; Ahri can aim Charm backward as he reappears.
Zed's Living Shadow used aggressively leaves him without that escape until it returns.
The Ahri versus Zed matchup favors Zed in lane and solo kills in the current aggregate.

turns.text:
**Win the wave before you try to win the all-in.** Stand behind your minions, punish Zed when he uses Razor Shuriken to farm, and make him choose between taking CS and taking damage. Don’t rush the wave under his tower; keep him close enough that he has to walk up for last hits.

**Living Shadow used to trade:** sidestep the shurikens, then step forward while his escape is down. Take a short trade and back out. Once he’s low enough, a missed Razor Shuriken or a spent Living Shadow is your opening to commit; *until then, keep farming and make him pay for CS*.

**Death Mark on you:** hold Charm until Zed reappears behind you, then cast it back toward him. Use Spirit Rush to create distance from his follow-up damage. Throwing Charm before he commits gives him the chance to dodge your best answer.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide : [Plat] Season 5 Ahri Guide
results.snippet: Save your charm for after he ults you because if you use it before then, he can use him ultimate to dodge your charm. … Right after he ults, you can time your charm to hit him immediately after he becomes vulnerable, meaning he will not be able to apply any damage. … After that, use your Spirit Rush to keep your distance against auto attacks, and dodge shurikens.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide : Ahri The Famous Nine Tails - Is too late for mercy
results.snippet: When Zed ults you he will appear behind Ahri, meaning that you have to throw your Charm backwards in order for it to hit. … Early game you can't really harass him much as he will stay back and throw his Shuriken (Q) at the minions. … Some Zeds will use there W aggressively to try and harass you, which also pushes the lane. This is a great time to get a gank as his only escape will be on cooldown.

results.title: Ahri Build Guide : Soulstealer Ahri; The Demon Fox of Mid Lane
results.snippet: Most Zeds must rely on Living Shadow to harass or farm from a distance rather than to escape or dodge. … Once you've dodge his shuriken, don't be afraid to retaliate, though be sure to keep your distance until Death Mark had popped. … The trick to dodging zed is to use Zhonya's while Zed is in "mid air" during the casting time of Death Mark.

data.answer: Ahri should hold Charm for Zed’s Death Mark: he appears behind her, so aim Charm backward as he becomes vulnerable, then use Spirit Rush to create distance and dodge his shurikens. Before level 6, farm cautiously and punish Zed when his Living Shadow is on cooldown; after level 6, sidestep or dash sideways/diagonally from his follow-up attacks, and consider Zhonya’s Hourglass.
